claims.content: The GUI shall allow the operator to acknowledge an alarm and have the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.

goal.raw_text: The GUI shall allow the operator to acknowledge an alarm and have the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.

claims.content: Operator
An alarm condition is active in the system
The operator has logged into a field unit or workstation with sufficient access level to acknowledge alarms
An alarm condition is generated and displayed to the operator via the GUI, requiring acknowledgment.

trigger.raw_text: An alarm condition is generated and displayed to the operator via the GUI, requiring acknowledgment.

claims.content: The GUI displays the Alarm Acknowledgment/Silencing Screen to the operator upon detection of an alarm condition.
The operator selects the option to acknowledge the active alarm via the GUI.
The system records the acknowledgment and updates the alarm status accordingly.
The operator is presented with the option to silence the audible portion of the alarm for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only.
If the operator chooses to silence the alarm, the system applies the selected silencing duration (configurable seconds or permanent) to the specific device generating the alarm.
If the operator chooses not to silence the alarm, the system continues to emit the audible alarm until manually silenced or the alarm condition clears.
If a critical alarm occurs during opening or closing operation, the system shall present the operator with possible actions that can be taken in order to complete the operation.
If overriding a device status is needed in order to proceed, the system shall determine if the operator has high enough security and provide advise on how to proceed.
If the operator does not have sufficient security level to acknowledge the alarm, the system shall deny the acknowledgment request and display an access denied message.
If the alarm condition is no longer active when the operator attempts to acknowledge it, the system shall prevent acknowledgment and update the display to reflect the cleared status.

If the GUI fails to render the Alarm Acknowledgment/Silencing Screen due to a system error, the system shall log the failure and notify the operator via an alternative method (e.g., system message or alert).
The alarm is acknowledged by the operator via the GUI.
The audible portion of the alarm is silenced for a configurable number of seconds or permanently for that device only, if selected by the operator.
The system records the acknowledgment action and updates the alarm status to reflect it has been acknowledged.
